description: Segment all customers of the online store into spend quartiles for calendar year 2025 and summarize each quartile. Spend = sum of completed order amounts with order_ts in 2025 (UTC); customers with no such orders have spend 0 and must be included. Assign quartiles with NTILE(4) over spend ascending, breaking ties by customer_id ascending (quartile 1 = lowest spend). Output columns: spend_quartile (INT64), customers (INT64), min_spend (FLOAT64), max_spend (FLOAT64), total_spend (FLOAT64). Sort by spend_quartile.
edge_cases: Customer 1 only ordered in 2024 and has spend 0 in 2025 but must be bucketed
6 customers into 4 buckets: NTILE gives bucket sizes 2, 2, 1, 1
Customers with equal spend need the customer_id tie-break to be deterministic
Customer 6 has two orders that must be summed before bucketing
common_failure_modes: FM1: INNER JOIN to orders drops zero-spend customers, shifting every quartile boundary
FM3: Applying NTILE to order rows instead of per-customer totals
FM7: Missing tie-breaker makes quartile assignment non-deterministic across runs
